extracted.name: Butter/ ghee chicken roast
extracted.description: Great recipe for Butter/ ghee chicken roast.
ingredient_lines: Half a teaspoon of fenugreek seeds
Add all the above dry roasted ingredients
Also add the blended paste of above masala
instruction_lines: Heat the pan with 3 cubes of butter / 3 spoons of ghee
Cook the chicken in slow flame for 30 min. Add little amount of water if required.
Cook it under it's dry and butter / ghee is seen on top.
You can have this with chapati/ bread or rice
